name: Back To Reality
source:
One girl against the world. Life takes an interesting turn... How will she survive the tragedies hurtled her way?  Who are her true allies? What is the truth of everything?

[From Itch.io]
translation:
一个女孩对抗整个世界。生活突然变得扑朔迷离……面对接踵而至的悲剧，她该如何生存？真正站在她这边的人是谁？这一切背后的真相又是什么？

[来源：Itch.io]
